chapter: 十四、辟《易林补遗》婚姻嫁娶之谬
chapter_en: Section 14: Refuting the Yilin Buyi on betrothal and marriage

units.chapter: 十四、辟《易林补遗》婚姻嫁娶之谬
units.chapter_en: Section 14: Refuting the Yilin Buyi on betrothal and marriage
units.title: 辟《易林补遗》婚姻嫁娶之谬：用神要按占的人与被占的人是什么关系来取，不能一概以内外卦、世应、财鬼论夫妇

rule.yi: 《易林补遗》一概拿内外卦、世应爻、阴阳财鬼来论夫妇，不管是谁在占、为谁占，这是大谬。王洪绪主张：世爻是我家、应爻是对方家；女人自己占嫁人，以官爻为丈夫，官世相生相合、官阳世阴才叫得地；男人自己占娶妻，以财爻为妻子，财世相生相合、财阴世阳才叫得地；父母尊长为子孙的婚事占，以子孙爻为用神，世上的子孙或阳象是我家的男孩，应上的子孙或阴象是对方的女孩；无冲破而有生合就可配、夫妻和谐，无生合而有冲克就夫妻不睦，休囚或受克就不长寿；为弟弟娶妻、妹妹出嫁占，都以兄弟爻为用神。
rule.en: The Yilin Buyi judges husband and wife by the inner and outer trigrams, the Self and Other lines, and yin, yang, Wealth and Pressure alike, without regard to who divines and for whom; this is a great mistake. Wang Hongxu holds: the Self line is my family and the Other line the other family; when a woman divines for herself about marrying, Pressure is the husband, and only if Pressure and Self generate and combine, with Pressure yang and Self yin, is it called being in place; when a man divines for himself about marrying, Wealth is the wife, and only if Wealth and Self generate and combine, with Wealth yin and Self yang, is it in place; when parents or elders divine the marriage of a child, Output is the Subject, with Output on Self or on a yang image the boy of my family and Output on Other or on a yin image the girl of the other family; with generation and combination and no clash or break they can be matched and are harmonious, with clash and control and no generation or combination they are at odds, and resting or controlled they will not live long; for a younger brother's marriage or a younger sister's, take the Peer line as the Subject.

zh: 婚姻嫁娶，唯《易林补遗》之说最谬，以内外卦世应爻为主，以阴阳财鬼爻为凭，凡男卜女家，内卦为夫外卦为妇；
又以世为夫应为妇，凡女卜男家，外卦为夫内卦为妇，世爻为妇应爻为夫等说，使后学无定见。
假如男家卜婚姻，或遇外卦凶而应爻吉，此婚姻亦好亦不好，竟可配不可配耶？
今人宗之，不问父母叔伯为卜子侄女婿，不问兄弟母舅为卜甥弟女婚，一概以世应论夫妇，官鬼妻财为夫妇，不以用神生克制化之理定其夫妇之吉凶，大失先天之妙旨。
孰知世应财官各有分别。
世爻为我家，应爻为彼家，女人自卜嫁此郎为夫，当以官爻为夫，世为自己，官世相生相合，官阳世阴，此谓之得地。
男人自卜娶此女为妻，当以财为妇，世为自己，财世相生相合，财阴世阳，亦谓之得地。
或父母尊长辈为子孙婚，欲配某家女为媳，以子孙为用神，世上子孙或阳象，子孙皆指我家之男也，应上子孙或阴象，子孙皆指言彼之女也。
无冲破有生合，自然可配，夫妇和谐，无生合有冲克，自然夫妇不睦，或休囚或受克自然不寿。
如父为子婚，世位而受伤者，自然悖逆而刑翁，财爻而受生者，自然孝顺而益。
或为弟娶妹嫁者，皆以兄弟爻为用神也。
yi: 婚姻嫁娶的说法，只有《易林补遗》最荒谬：它以内外卦、世应爻为主，以阴阳、财鬼爻为凭据，凡是男方占女家，内卦是丈夫、外卦是妻子；
又以世爻为丈夫、应爻为妻子，凡是女方占男家，外卦是丈夫、内卦是妻子，世爻是妻子、应爻是丈夫等等，使后来的学者没有定见。
假如男家占婚姻，遇到外卦凶而应爻吉，这桩婚姻既好又不好，到底可配还是不可配呢？
现在的人都宗奉它，不问是父母叔伯替子侄女婿占，不问是兄弟母舅替外甥弟弟女儿的婚事占，一概拿世应论夫妇，拿官鬼妻财当夫妇，不按用神生克制化的道理来定这对夫妇的吉凶，大大失去了先天的妙旨。
谁知道世、应、财、官各有分别。
世爻是我家，应爻是对方家；女人自己占嫁给这个男子，应当以官爻为丈夫，世爻是自己，官世相生相合，官阳世阴，这叫得地。
男人自己占娶这个女子为妻，应当以财爻为妻子，世爻是自己，财世相生相合，财阴世阳，也叫得地。
或者父母、尊长替子孙的婚事占，想给某家的女儿做儿媳，以子孙爻为用神，世爻上的子孙或阳象，子孙都是指我家的男孩，应爻上的子孙或阴象，子孙都是指对方的女孩。
没有冲破、有生合，自然可配，夫妻和谐；没有生合、有冲克，自然夫妻不睦，休囚或者受克，自然不长寿。
如果是父亲替儿子办婚事，世爻上受伤的，自然是媳妇悖逆而刑克公公，财爻受生的，自然孝顺而有益。
或者替弟弟娶妻、妹妹出嫁占，都以兄弟爻为用神。
en: Of the sayings on betrothal and marriage, only that of the Yilin Buyi is the most mistaken: it takes the inner and outer trigrams and the Self and Other lines as the main thing, and yin and yang and the Wealth and Pressure lines as the evidence; whenever a man divines about a woman's family, the inner trigram is the husband and the outer trigram the wife;

and it also takes Self as husband and Other as wife; whenever a woman divines about a man's family, the outer trigram is the husband and the inner trigram the wife, and Self is the wife and Other the husband, and so on, leaving later students with no settled view.
Suppose a man's family divines a marriage and meets an ill outer trigram and a lucky Other line: is the marriage both good and not good, a match that can and cannot be made?

People today follow it: without asking whether parents or uncles are divining for a son, nephew or son-in-law, or brothers or a maternal uncle for a nephew, a younger brother or a daughter's marriage, they judge husband and wife by Self and Other indiscriminately, take Pressure and Wealth as husband and wife, and do not settle the luck of the couple by the principle of the Subject's generation, control, restraint and change, which greatly loses the fine purport of the primal Way.
Who knows that Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure each have their own distinctions.

The Self line is my family and the Other line the other family. When a woman divines for herself about marrying this man, Pressure should be taken as the husband and Self as herself; if Pressure and Self generate and combine, with Pressure yang and Self yin, this is called being in place.

When a man divines for himself about marrying this woman, Wealth should be taken as the wife and Self as himself; if Wealth and Self generate and combine, with Wealth yin and Self yang, this too is called being in place.

Or when parents or elders divine the marriage of a child, wishing to match a girl of some family as a daughter-in-law, take Output as the Subject: Output on Self or on a yang image always means the male of my family, and Output on Other or on a yin image always means the girl of the other family.

With no clash or break and with generation or combination, they can naturally be matched and husband and wife are harmonious; with no generation or combination but clash and control, husband and wife are naturally at odds, and if resting or trapped or controlled, they will naturally not live long.

If a father divines a son's marriage and the line at Self is injured, the bride will naturally be unruly and injure her father-in-law; if the Wealth line is generated, she will naturally be filial and beneficial.
Or for a younger brother's marriage or a younger sister's, always take the Peer line as the Subject.

zh: 曾有午建乙卯日父为女择婿，得否卦安静；
yi: 曾经有一个人，午月乙卯日，父亲替女儿选女婿，得否卦，六爻安静；
en: Once, in the Wu month on a Yi-Mao day, a father chose a husband for his daughter and got the hexagram Pi, with all lines still;

zh: 一人执此卦问予曰：“世阴应阳，官星旺合，卦得六合，日辰持财，财官相生，六爻安静，是必佳偶乎？”
予曰：“若依张星元论，是佳偶也，子孙伏而旬空，是必无子息也；
据予断，子水子孙伏阴爻未土之下，唯恐令爱不寿耳。”
其人不然而去，后成婚不久，此女病故。
yi: 一个人拿着这个卦问我说：「世阴应阳，官星旺而相合，卦得六合，日辰持财，财官相生，六爻安静，这一定是一对佳偶吧？」
我说：「如果照张星元的说法，是佳偶，子孙伏藏而且旬空，必定没有子息；
照我的断法，子水子孙伏在阴爻未土之下，只怕令爱不长寿罢了。」
那个人不以为然就走了，后来成婚不久，这个女子病死了。
en: A man held this hexagram and asked me: 'Self yin and Other yang, the Pressure star strong and combining, the hexagram six-combine, the Day holding Wealth, Wealth and Pressure generating each other, all six lines still: surely a fine match?'
I said: 'By Zhang Xingyuan's theory it is a fine match, but Output is hidden and Void in its ten-day period, so surely there will be no children;
by my judgement, Zi Water Output is hidden under the yin Wei Earth line, and I fear only that your dear daughter will not live long.'
The man did not agree and left; later the marriage was made, and before long the girl died of illness.

zh: 又一人，申月甲午日，父为子择媳得复之噬嗑卦：
yi: 又一个人，申月甲午日，父亲替儿子选媳妇，得复卦变噬嗑卦：
en: Another man, in the Shen month on a Jia-Wu day, a father choosing a daughter-in-law for his son, got the hexagram Fu changing to Shihe:

zh: 予曰：“应爻合成子孙局生世，不但嫁资丰厚，更可享其孝顺之福。
后至巳年完婚，果孝顺贤淑，赠嫁不凡。
若据张星元之说，官为夫，此卦寅木夫星月破，又被金局克，是必克夫，何完婚已二十年，翁姑在堂，夫妇和谐，不唯子多，已近得孙矣！
后学当如是断，庶无弃吉就凶，以至误人婚配也。
yi: 我说：「应爻合成子孙局生世，不但嫁妆丰厚，更能享受她孝顺的福。
后来到巳年完婚，果然孝顺贤淑，陪嫁不凡。
如果照张星元的说法，官爻是丈夫，这个卦寅木夫星月破，又被金局克，必定克夫，可是完婚已经二十年，公婆都在堂上，夫妻和谐，不但儿子多，已经快抱孙子了！
后来的学者应当这样断，才不会舍弃吉的、就着凶的，以致耽误人家的婚配。
en: I said: 'The Other line combines into an Output frame and generates Self, so not only will the dowry be rich, but you will also enjoy the blessing of her filial devotion.
In the Si year the wedding was held, and she was indeed filial, virtuous and gentle, with an outstanding dowry.

By Zhang Xingyuan's theory, Pressure is the husband, and here the Yin Wood husband-star is under a Month-break and controlled by the Metal frame, so it would surely mean harm to the husband; yet twenty years after the wedding the parents-in-law are still in the hall, husband and wife are in harmony, and not only are there many sons, but he is almost at the point of having grandchildren!
Later students should judge in this way, so that they do not abandon the lucky for the unlucky and mislead a marriage.

dispute.yi: 这是王洪绪对《易林补遗》婚姻说法的正面批评（LY.MARRY.YL.05、YL.06、YL.20、YL.21）：《易林补遗》一概按内外卦、世应、财鬼论夫妇，王洪绪要求先分清是谁在占、替谁占，再按这层关系取用神。《增删卜易》也讲代占与自占取用不同（LY.MARRY.ZS.04）。
dispute.en: This is Wang Hongxu's direct attack on the Yilin Buyi's teaching on marriage (LY.MARRY.YL.05, YL.06, YL.20 and YL.21): the Yilin Buyi judges husband and wife throughout by the inner and outer trigrams, Self and Other, and Wealth and Pressure, whereas Wang Hongxu requires first telling who is divining and for whom, and choosing the Subject by that relation. The Zengshan Buyi likewise distinguishes taking the Subject for a proxy from taking it for oneself (LY.MARRY.ZS.04).

note.yi: 张星元即《易林补遗》的作者张世宝（字星元）。「先天之妙旨」指易的本意，书里没有再解释。第三、四、五段是两个卦例，卦图（六爻的排列）不收，只收卦图前后的文字；第二个卦例的前一句在卦图之前。
note.en: Zhang Xingyuan is the author of the Yilin Buyi, Zhang Shibao. 'The fine purport of the primal Way' means the original intent of the Changes and is not explained further. The third to fifth passages belong to two cases, whose hexagram diagrams (the arrangement of the six lines) are not included, only the text before and after the diagrams; the second case's first sentence comes before its diagram.

units.chapter: 十五、合处逢冲、冲中逢合论
units.chapter_en: Section 15: On a combination meeting a clash and a clash meeting a combination
units.title: 合处逢冲、冲中逢合各有三种：合处逢冲谋虽成而终散、冲中逢合事已散而复成；占婚六合卦而世被日冲、应爻月破，也叫合处逢冲，总不言吉

rule.yi: 合处逢冲有三种：六合卦变成六冲卦；日辰、月建冲爻；动爻变成冲。冲中逢合也有三种，方向相反。合处逢冲，谋划虽然成了最后还是散；冲中逢合，事情已经散了又成。占婚姻时，卦是六合，可是世爻被日辰冲、应爻月破，也是合处逢冲，不说吉；书中例：辰月丁酉日自占婚姻得否卦，当月自己大病，未月世爻和财爻入墓，那个女子病死。
rule.en: There are three kinds of a combination meeting a clash: a six-combine hexagram changing into a six-clash hexagram; the Day or Month clashing a line; a moving line changing into a clash; and three kinds of a clash meeting a combination, in the opposite direction. With a combination meeting a clash, the plan is made but in the end scatters; with a clash meeting a combination, the matter has scattered and is then made. In a marriage divination, if the hexagram is six-combine but Self is clashed by the Day and the Other line is under a Month-break, that too is a combination meeting a clash and is not called lucky; the case in the book: on a Ding-You day in the Chen month a man divined for himself about a marriage and got Pi; that month he fell gravely ill himself, and in the Wei month, Self and Wealth entering the tomb, the girl died of illness.

zh: 合处逢冲有三：凡得六合变六冲，一也；
日月冲爻，二也；
动爻变冲，三也。
冲中逢合亦有三：凡得六冲变六合，一也；
日月合爻，二也；
动爻变合，三也。
合处逢冲，谋虽成而终散；
冲中逢合，事已散而复成。
yi: 合处逢冲有三种：得六合卦变成六冲卦，是第一种；
日辰、月建冲爻，是第二种；
动爻变成冲，是第三种。
冲中逢合也有三种：得六冲卦变成六合卦，是第一种；
日辰、月建合爻，是第二种；
动爻变成合，是第三种。
合处逢冲，谋划虽然成了，最终还是散；
冲中逢合，事情已经散了又成。
en: There are three kinds of a combination meeting a clash: a six-combine hexagram changing into a six-clash hexagram is the first;
the Day or Month clashing a line is the second;
a moving line changing into a clash is the third.
There are also three kinds of a clash meeting a combination: a six-clash hexagram changing into a six-combine hexagram is the first;
the Day or Month combining a line is the second;
a moving line changing into a combination is the third.
With a combination meeting a clash, the plan is made but in the end scatters;
with a clash meeting a combination, the matter has scattered and is then made.

zh: 辰月丁酉日，自占婚姻成否，得否卦：
yi: 辰月丁酉日，自己占婚姻成不成，得否卦：
en: In the Chen month on a Ding-You day, a man divined for himself whether a marriage would be made, and got the hexagram Pi:

zh: 断曰：卦得六合，婚姻最宜，今世被日冲，应爻月破，谓之合处逢冲，总不言吉。
彼曰年庚已经送来，算命又说甚佳，答曰：予屡占屡验，故敢此断。
果于本月自得大病，未月世财入墓，此女病故。
yi: 断语：卦是六合，最宜婚姻，可现在世爻被日辰冲，应爻月破，这叫合处逢冲，总的说来不说吉。
他说年庚已经送来了，算命的又说很好，我回答说：我屡次占屡次应验，所以敢这样断。
果然就在这个月他自己得了大病，未月世爻和财爻入墓，这个女子病死了。
en: Judgement: the hexagram is six-combine and most suitable for a marriage, but now Self is clashed by the Day and the Other line is under a Month-break, which is called a combination meeting a clash, and altogether I would not call it lucky.

He said the birth-dates had already been sent over and the fortune-teller had called them most auspicious; I answered: 'I have divined many times and been proved right many times, so I dare to judge so.'
Indeed, in that very month he fell gravely ill himself, and in the Wei month, with Self and Wealth entering the tomb, the girl died of illness.

note.yi: 这一节讲的三种合处逢冲，《易冒》里的「合冲」（LY.MARRY.YM.25）只是其中第二种（六合的卦被日辰冲害在世应上）。卦例的卦图不收。
note.en: Of the three kinds of a combination meeting a clash set out here, the Yi Mao's 'combination-clash' (LY.MARRY.YM.25) is only the second (a six-combine hexagram whose Self or Other is clashed or harmed by the Day). The case's hexagram diagram is not included.
